hypothesis: Train actual material class contrast on supported matched proposals rather than independent objectness BCE; isolate deployment common logit drift through differentiable full-supported-class centering and a frozen strong availability-aware proposal anchor.

feature_schema.source: Existing aligned CLC source+unchanged PID/Hi; third aligned CT plus original six-test N auxiliary caches; no new query decoder or encoder
feature_schema.residual_constant_guard: Fit only original grouped train class_valid X; identical for real/permuted. Permute whole raw M8..11 supported rows before applying same constant guard.
feature_schema.gate_constant_guard: Fit only original unpermuted grouped train proposal gate_context; shared between roles.

training.validation: Full source-val conditional pairwise loss only, weighted equal source->eligible image->eligible proposal; fixed label-free control permutation. Regularizer is train-only and is not checkpoint selection loss. Initial epoch -1 branch0 eligible. No CT/test in fitting or checkpoint selection.
training.objective: conditional weighted pairwise positive-vs-zero + .01 regularizer weighted mean_{supported} centered_delta^2
training.source_weighting: equal source -> image -> proposal, eligibility only for classification population

permutation.target: Whole M8..11 row vectors within the same proposal truly supported canonical class set; G/availability/padding/class labels unchanged
permutation.validation_test: seed+fold_or_case+canonical proposal key; fixed no epoch
permutation.algorithm: Uniform permutation without replacement, including possible fixed points; independent label-free RNG stream, never keyed by y/GT/loss/test AP

training.positive_teacher: Existing per-class maximum same-class GT IoU, IoU>=.5 retained else0; no new GT and no onehot matching; multiple positives retained

architecture.centered_delta: a_ic*(raw_delta_ic - mean_{c in actual_supported_i} raw_delta_ic)/2; differentiable during training
architecture.mean_precision: CUDA Float32 raw delta, supported sum/mean Float64 in canonical class order; centered Float64 finally Float32
architecture.unsupported: T<=1/queryinvalid/unsupported exact0 newdelta; formal old Tavailability deployment q exact fallback
architecture.center_role: Isolates common deployment logit drift. Supported common anchor and center terms cancel algebraically in positive-vs-zero rank differences; centering itself is not an extra supervision signal.

gate_context.precision: CPU Float64 from original unpermuted canonical supported B values, finally cast Float32

routing.anchor_locked: Fixed archived T availability_control alpha1 adaptive_router branch/category with E3 fixed lambda.5; never Kgeometry_locked
routing.adaptive_router: Use each new mixed quality, strict qF-qV>0, equal prefersV; native candidates/negative/UNC untouched

mixing.head: CPUFloat32 sigmoid of GPUFloat32 anchor/correction; per-seed thenF64mean ->F32
mixing.composition: F64 clippedpowers E^.5*head^.5 thenF32; alpha0 exact archived Kgeometry mixedquality

selection.criterion: Max shared .5AP(material)+.5AP(permuted_material) source CLC_tune only; exact tie smaller alpha then anchor_locked

budget.strong_Tavailability_baseline: Archived exact references; no new actual AP budget claimed

strong_anchor.q: Reconstruct original formal endpoint CPUFloat32 dense sigmoid(anchor_logits+old_delta), zero olddelta/unsupported copies old Kseed q; Float64 seedmean toF32 then original E3 mix
strong_anchor.candidate_anchor_logits: Original T saved full_logits exact bytes; new fullC GPU anchor gather checked but not substituted to introduce ULP drift
